text: The lair opens under a low ceiling. Torn strips of leather hang from a niche in the wall. Something growls from the dark—a gaunt tunnel-hound, ribs sharp under patchy hide, jaws wet with saliva. It plants its paws and waits for you to move. There is no quiet way past.
